title: A registered check from a retired named root blocks acceptance evaluation with no way to record a waiver
outcome: When an item's only registered check belongs to a retired named root and is invalid or irrelevant, a coordinator-recorded waiver, or a supported "retired-root check" disposition, lets the independent evaluation proceed and judge the criteria, instead of termal_evaluate_acceptance refusing forever with registered_check_root_rebound.
acceptance: A behavioural test shows termal_evaluate_acceptance proceeding for an item whose only registered check belongs to a retired root once that check is disposed of by a recorded, attributed waiver or an equivalent supported disposition. Without one, it still refuses with registered_check_root_rebound, as today.
The disposition is visible to the evaluator and in the item's evidence, with the waiver's author and reason, and does not credit the stale check as a pass.
The change has a clean review pair and passes the full gate.
